Parallel — social mockup maker

Parallel is a free design tool for making fictional social media mockups (chat threads, posts, profiles and stories) for storyboards, fan fiction, screenwriting, UI presentations and video edits. Mockups are built in your browser and exported as PNG images; nothing is published by this site.

Mockups are for fiction, illustration and design work only — not for impersonating anyone or presenting a mockup as a genuine message.

Not affiliated with Apple, Meta, Instagram, Facebook, X, Discord or TikTok. Contact: Discord. This page requires JavaScript to display.
